```python {.marimo}
#| include: false
#| error: false
def achievement_controls(kind, rows, set_rows):
    # A top-level UI array makes edits inside dynamic entries reactive.
    # Keep callbacks bound to its clones, including when adding/deleting rows.
    forms = mo.ui.array([item_form(mo, kind, row) for row in rows])
    title = "科研" if kind == "research" else "奖项 / 测评"
    buttons = [mo.ui.button(label=f"删除{title} {i + 1}",
               on_click=lambda _, index=i: set_rows([row for j, row in enumerate(forms.value) if j != index]))
               for i in range(len(forms))]
    add = mo.ui.button(label=f"＋ 添加{title}条目", on_click=lambda _: set_rows([*forms.value, {}]))
    cards = [mo.accordion({f"{title} {i + 1}": mo.vstack([form.vstack(), buttons[i]])})
             for i, form in enumerate(forms)]
    return forms, [*buttons, add], mo.vstack([*cards, add])
```
